questions.q: A can do a piece of work in 12 days and B can do it in 24 days. Working together, they finish it in
questions.e: Together they do 1/12 + 1/24 = 1/8 of the work a day, so 8 days.

questions.q: A pipe can fill a tank in 6 hours and another pipe can empty it in 12 hours. If both are opened together, the empty tank fills in
questions.e: Net rate = 1/6 − 1/12 = 1/12 of the tank per hour, so 12 hours.

questions.q: 8 men can finish a job in 15 days. How many days will 12 men take to finish the same job?
A can finish a work in 12 days and B in 24 days. They work together for 4 days and then B leaves. A alone finishes the rest in
questions.e: In 4 days they do 4 × 1/8 = 1/2 of the work. A does the remaining 1/2 in 12 × ½ = 6 days.

questions.q: A alone can do a job in 6 days and B alone in 12 days. They complete it together and are paid ₹1800. A's share is
questions.e: Wages go in the ratio of work done, which is the ratio of efficiency 1/6 : 1/12 = 2 : 1. A gets 2/3 of 1800 = ₹1200.

questions.q: Pipes A and B can fill a tank in 10 hours and 15 hours, and an outlet C can empty it in 30 hours. If all three are open, the empty tank fills in
questions.e: Net rate = 1/10 + 1/15 − 1/30 = 4/30 = 2/15 of the tank per hour, so 15/2 = 7.5 hours.

questions.q: A is twice as efficient as B. Together they finish a work in 18 days. A alone would take
questions.e: If A takes x days, B takes 2x. So 1/x + 1/(2x) = 1/18, which gives 3/(2x) = 1/18 and x = 27 days.

questions.q: A and B together can do a work in 12 days, B and C in 15 days, and C and A in 20 days. A alone can do it in
questions.e: Adding the three rates gives 2(A + B + C) = 1/12 + 1/15 + 1/20 = 1/5, so A + B + C = 1/10. Then A = 1/10 − 1/15 = 1/30, so 30 days.

questions.q: A tank is filled by a pump in 6 hours. Because of a leak, it takes 8 hours to fill. If the tank is full, the leak alone will empty it in
questions.e: Leak rate = 1/6 − 1/8 = 1/24 of the tank per hour, so the leak empties a full tank in 24 hours.

questions.q: A can complete a work in 20 days and B in 30 days. They start together, but A leaves 5 days before the work is finished. The work is completed in
questions.e: Let the work last x days. B works x days and A works x − 5 days: (x − 5)/20 + x/30 = 1, so 3(x − 5) + 2x = 60 and x = 15.
